The Moon and Venus shared a secret overnight.

The Moon in Libra met retrograde Venus overnight, makes a friendly sextile to Jupiter today and slips into Scorpio this evening. Swipe for Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn, plus one question to journal on today.

Save this for tonight, or send it to your Earth friend. 🌙
